days.reason: This is the main text for Christ the King Sunday (Domens søndag). The parable of the sheep and the goats (verses 31-46) is the central passage describing the final judgment at Christ's return, which is the theme of this day. The text is explicitly mentioned in today's description.

The parable of the ten virgins (verses 1-13) is part of the same chapter and deals with being ready for the Lord's coming. It is often used as a preparatory text to the parable of the sheep and the goats on Christ the King Sunday, focusing on 'keeping watch' and not knowing the day or the hour (verse 13).

The parable of the talents (verses 14-30) is also part of Matthew 25 and deals with responsibility and faithfulness during the waiting period before the Lord comes to settle accounts. It is often read in connection with Christ the King Sunday or during Lent as an exhortation to use God's gifts, but it is not the main text for Christ the King Sunday in the same way as the sheep and the goats.
